# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version of OctoPrint-Slack.
Older releases may not receive security updates.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report suspected vulnerabilities in a public issue.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting][private-report] to share the impact,
affected versions, reproduction steps, and any suggested remediation. Please
allow time for a fix and a coordinated release before publishing details.

Never include a working Slack webhook URL or other credential in a report. Use a
redacted or revoked example instead.

[private-report]: https://github.com/mkevenaar/OctoPrint-Slack/security/advisories/new
